methodology.scope: 1512 entries from the official 2026 season player directory, not a claim that every entry is on a 26-player game roster.
methodology.classes: C/B/A/S; NORMAL grade independently for all base editions. Original twelve editions retain released values.

hitters.class: OPS percentile: S>=90, A>=70, B>=40, otherwise C. Subthreshold entries provisional C.
hitters.attributes: Same percentile conversion as the released twelve; Luck neutral 60.

pitchers.role: SP if at least 3 starts and starts/appearances>=20%; otherwise RP.
pitchers.score: 45% lower ERA percentile +25% lower WHIP percentile +30% K-minus-BB per batter faced percentile, compared within SP/RP. Same class thresholds; provisional C below minimum workload.
pitchers.attributes: CONTROL from BB/BF, STUFF from K/BF, STAMINA from outs/appearance; not measured pitch velocity.
pitchers.gameplay: Directory/categorization only; pitchers do not enter special-batter slots.

methodology.art: Approved twelve preserved. Remaining entries require their own generated sprite before entering special-batter draw pools.
